obligations.summary: Providers must take appropriate measures to comply with obligations set out in Articles 53 and 54 when requested by the Commission.
Providers must implement mitigation measures when the Commission requests them following an evaluation that has given rise to serious and substantiated concern of a systemic risk at Union level.
Providers must restrict the making available on the market, withdraw, or recall the general-purpose AI model when requested by the Commission.

Providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk that offer commitments during structured dialogue may have those commitments made legally binding by Commission decision, precluding further action.
exceptions: Where the provider offers sufficient commitments during structured dialogue, the Commission may declare no further grounds for action, relieving the provider of additional measures.
